about.text: Rushan is a cow's milk cheese of Yunnan, China. It is traditionally made by the Bai people, who call it nvxseiz, the etymology of which is unclear.

how.text: Fresh curd is pulled into thin sheets, wrapped on long bamboo sticks and hung to dry. The acid or coagulant used was not found in any opened source, so none is named.
